<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty surged over 800 points and 1%, respectively, reclaiming the 23,000 mark, driven by optimism surrounding a potential India-US trade deal and strong performance in IT and Reliance Industries shares.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQdWFsM1JVU0pMb3hmUE1OWGVUQkMxZTNmNzcxcWNnRW5yUW9uRXZVT0FJWGJDYThYZlpkcmZFaG5IUmtwdE81dUxNSWNkck95RVdGUjMtV0ZLUGZ4RHQ3S0dLQk5QbkVaMHRNVllwakQ4RWNhcWwtZFRILWlKNlZEVDJ4SENYb2d1SW5zRzNHdFFBZ3pZTklIXzVUU1I5cFAtaS1fVnVoandYZTRNcnNVag?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Energy and geopolitics:</strong> Rising crude oil prices, with Brent exceeding $110, alongside ongoing US-Iran tensions remain key monitorables for investors despite the positive sentiment in domestic equity markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
